messages:
elaine: planning to start a fractional rollout for v2.3.1 tonight 22:00 UTC. @jamal and @alex will run the deploy. need smoke owners and rollback readiness. plan below

elaine: rollout plan (brief):
```
22:00 UTC  -> 0.5%  (NA web only)
22:10 UTC  -> 2%
22:25 UTC  -> 10%
22:55 UTC  -> 25%
23:30 UTC  -> 50%
04:00 UTC (next day) -> 100%
```

jamal: ack, i'll kick off the deploy at 22:00 and watch infra metrics. i'll post each step start/complete

alex: i'm available for the first three ramps (0.5, 2, 10). what are the smoke asserts we should use?

priya: smoke checklist i suggest:
- sampling: 25 requests/sec for 5m against NA web cohort
- HTTP 200 rate > 99.9%
- 95th p95 latency < 300ms on avg model path
- error rate delta < 0.1% vs baseline
- no new stack traces in /logs/service (grep ERROR)
- quick sanity prompts for model quality (2 prompts)

alex: perfect — i'll run those and share short snippets/results. i'll ping @oncall if p50 or p95 jumps by >2x or error rate spikes

elaine: rollback plan: if we need to stop we pause ramp and run `scripts/rollback.sh v2.3.1` then revert traffic via router toggle (internal tool). todd, can you confirm rollback playbook link?

todd: confirmed. rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollback-playbook (steps 1-5). primary rollback command is:
```
./scripts/rollback.sh v2.3.1 --force
```
also have `kubectl rollout undo` as a fallback. i'll be on standby for DB/infra queries

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled by @elaine for 3338001234: v2.3.1 fractional plan created. watch /ops/rollouts for automated step updates

jamal: quick note — cohort mappings: 0.5% -> NA web mobile UA bucket, 2% -> NA web all, 10% -> EU web, 25% -> NA+EU web, 50% -> include APAC shadow (no write)

priya: i'll be capturing smoke logs and posting a short table after each step. tagging @alex and @elaine for final signoff per step :thumbsup:

alex: ack, will sign off live. if anything flaky we pause and coordinate rollback. :hand:

elaine: thanks team. i'll start the deploy at 22:00 and post updates. if no major issues we'll hit 50% by 23:30. good to go?

jamal: go for launch. :rocket:
